snippet.title: MotoGP™26 - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#MotoGP26 arrives on April 29. 🏁
Take on the 2026 MotoGP™ season with a more authentic riding physics, train like real riders with Ultimate Race Off, and and race online with full cross-play when the lights go out. 

📘Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/motoGPVideogame
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/motogpvideogame/
📱 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/S47gpx5vE2
🌍 Website: https://motogpvideogame.com/
